mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant 67 degrees and clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. If you are out tonight, keep an eye out for the space station pass starting at 10:22 PM, which will travel from the Cross Plains direction toward Oregon and reach halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona provides important information through the VHAT cable channel, which features local government meetings and community news. Additionally, please remember that vehicles parked in residential areas must be stored in designated parking spaces at least five feet from property lines.

Today is a great day for community activities, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School and Hop Haus Trivia.
In a recent report, on July 13, officers arrested a 36-year-old Madison man for an O-W-I after a passerby reported his vehicle was stuck on a rock.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. Culver's is open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
